title: MCP for Investing & Portfolio Intelligence
author: TankNegative7921
selftext:
Hi guys, 

Are here any people deep on MCPs in investing? 

I created one few weeks ago: [https://github.com/Investboard/ai-toolkit](https://github.com/Investboard/ai-toolkit)

The plugin is also directly available in ChatGPT:

[https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin\_asdk\_app\_6acd243688888191a3eda79bea1ca0d0](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6acd243688888191a3eda79bea1ca0d0)

AI on its own is not a reliable partner for discussions around finances. People do it anyway. I wonder what their results are.

Connecting your AI to premium data and logic should actually make it worthwhile. 

My MCP has 22 tools connecting to my software, data and calculations.

Through this MCP and [investboard.com](http://investboard.com/) subscription your agent can:

* **Understand your portfolio:** examine holdings, underlying equity fund exposures, overlap, concentration and historical correlations.
* **Check ideas against your strategy:** assess a proposed investment or rebalance against your own goals, allocation rules and limits.
* **Connect decisions over time:** retrieve investment theses, journal entries and earlier checks, then record the decision you choose.

Any tries, feedbacks or GitHub stars are much appreciated.

I will write about it in more details in my upcoming articles. Follow me for updates.

Thank you!
